name: bounded-signed-input-kernels-v1
coordinates: original ordinal input token coordinates divided by n-1, in the exact routed source block
bank: current gated context plus affine and quadratic polynomial kernels and constant-plus-Gaussian kernels; axes [1,1],[4,1],[1,4], ridge0.001/0.1, Gaussian lengths1/32,1/16,1/8,1/4,1/2,1;49 maps total
kernel_weights: solve (K+ridge*I)w=k(query,observed); normalize by max(1,sum(abs(w))) using outward absolute-mass accumulation and downward quotient magnitudes
solver: deterministic Cholesky; verify full inverse residual<=1e-7, reject nonfinite or nonpositive pivots; refused block/kernel uses baseline
kernel_block_limit: 256 observations; larger block/kernel fits explicitly refuse and retain baseline
eligibility: known unseen input in an ambiguous block with no earlier hull or either exclusion row; overlapping observed class hulls are allowed because CM51 does not assume convex target regions
diagnostic: original record order and multiplicities; exclude the entire source state using the inverse Schur identity, without refitting latent discovery; canonical complete conjugate head at margin24; ordinary full-vocabulary CE
baseline: reconstruct current gated source-excluded weights and reproduce its complete original diagnostic before selection
selection: best diagnostic vertex then CM45 convex mixture with frozen canonical head; increasing index ties, CE improvement1e-10
mini: 8 diagnostic epochs in original order with inherited minibatch size and its short tail
forward: best diagnostic vertex; zero new gradients or optimizer updates
inference: mix actual complete parent features and signed complex source features, then apply every unchanged real/imaginary head coefficient; a pure baseline uses the exact parent
observed_rows: exact original parent; unchanged records, coefficients, observed CE and complete-head derivatives
scope: fixed ordinal kernel bias with bounded signed features; flatness does not identify unknown labels; original all35 comparison follows component review
